# shopify_discount_basic (Resource)

An amount-off discount: a percentage or a fixed amount off selected products, collections or the whole order, as a code discount (`code` set) or an automatic one (`code` unset). **Volatile, usually a poor fit for Terraform:** promotions are created, changed and ended in the admin by marketing, and every admin edit to a managed attribute is reverted on the next apply. Long-running rules, such as a newsletter code, fit Terraform; attributes you leave unset are not managed. Destroying a discount deletes it; orders keep their discount applications, but a recreated discount counts its uses from zero. Bulk codes, tags, subscription settings and app discounts are not managed. Generated config holds product, collection, segment and market GIDs, which tie it to the store: replace them with references. An existing discount with the same code, or an automatic one with the same title, needs `adopt_existing = true`; destroy then leaves it in place. Import with `code/<code>` or `automatic/<title>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Code discount: 10 % off one collection for newsletter subscribers, from 30 € on.
resource "shopify_discount_basic" "newsletter" {
  title = "Newsletter 10 %"
  code  = "WILLKOMMEN10"

  # Compared by instant: Shopify returns UTC, the spelling here stays.
  starts_at = "2026-11-01T00:00:00+01:00"
  ends_at   = "2026-12-31T23:59:59+01:00"

  # Reference segments, so deleting one updates the discount first (a discount whose only segment is deleted expires).
  context = { customer_segment_ids = [shopify_customer_segment.subscribers.id] }

  customer_gets = {
    value = { percentage = 0.1 }
    items = { collection_ids = [shopify_collection.pflegehilfsmittel.id] }
  }
  minimum_requirement       = { subtotal = "30.00" }
  combines_with             = { shipping_discounts = true }
  usage_limit               = 1000
  applies_once_per_customer = true
}

# Automatic discount: 5 € off every order. Unset attributes stay with the admin.
resource "shopify_discount_basic" "five_off" {
  title = "5 € Rabatt"

  customer_gets = {
    value = { amount = { amount = "5.00" } }
    items = { all = true }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `customer_gets` (Attributes) What the customer gets. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--customer_gets))
- `title` (String) The discount's name in the admin and at checkout. Unique among automatic discounts; code discounts may share titles.

### Optional

- `adopt_existing` (Boolean) Take over an existing discount with the same natural key instead of failing. Destroy then only removes it from state. Defaults to `false`.
- `applies_once_per_customer` (Boolean) Whether each customer can use the code only once. Code discounts only. Unset means unmanaged.
- `code` (String) The code customers enter; unset makes an automatic discount. Unique per shop, ignoring case; Shopify keeps the case as given. Changing the code renames it in place, but setting or removing it replaces the discount, which restarts its usage count. Discounts with several codes can be imported by any of them, but their code can't be changed here.
- `combines_with` (Attributes) Which other discount classes it combines with. All `false` when created without it. Unset means unmanaged. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--combines_with))
- `context` (Attributes) Who can use the discount: exactly one of `all`, `customer_segment_ids` or `market_ids`. A code discount created without it is open to all buyers. Reference `shopify_customer_segment` IDs: deleting a discount's only segment expires the discount and resets it to all buyers, and the reference makes Terraform update the discount first. A discount for individual customers, or with a context Shopify doesn't describe, reads as null and can't be managed here. Unset means unmanaged. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--context))
- `ends_at` (String) When the discount ends, as an RFC 3339 time; null means no end. Setting it in the past ends the discount. An end date set in the admin can't be removed here: set a far end date instead. Unset means unmanaged.
- `minimum_requirement` (Attributes) The minimum the order must reach: at most one of `subtotal` and `quantity`; `{}` removes the minimum. Unset means unmanaged. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--minimum_requirement))
- `starts_at` (String) When the discount starts, as an RFC 3339 time such as `2026-11-01T00:00:00+01:00`. Shopify returns UTC; the instant is compared, so the configured spelling stays. Created as now when unset. Unset means unmanaged.
- `usage_limit` (Number) How often the code can be used in total; null means unlimited. Code discounts only. A limit set in the admin can't be removed here: set a high limit instead. Unset means unmanaged.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `DiscountCodeNode` or `DiscountAutomaticNode` GID.
- `status` (String) `ACTIVE`, `SCHEDULED` or `EXPIRED`, from the dates.

<a id="nestedatt--customer_gets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `customer_gets`

Required:

- `items` (Attributes) Which items are discounted: exactly one of `all`, `product_ids` and/or `variant_ids`, or `collection_ids`. Changes are written as additions and removals against the live selection. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--customer_gets--items))
- `value` (Attributes) The discount value: exactly one of `percentage` or `amount`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--customer_gets--value))

<a id="nestedatt--customer_gets--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `customer_gets.items`

Optional:

- `all` (Boolean) All items, which makes it an order discount. Must be `true`.
- `collection_ids` (Set of String) Collection GIDs; reference `shopify_collection` IDs.
- `product_ids` (Set of String) Product GIDs; reference `shopify_product` IDs.
- `variant_ids` (Set of String) Product variant GIDs.


<a id="nestedatt--customer_gets--value"></a>
### Nested Schema for `customer_gets.value`

Optional:

- `amount` (Attributes) A fixed amount off. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--customer_gets--value--amount))
- `percentage` (Number) A fraction greater than 0 and at most 1, such as `0.1` for 10 %.

<a id="nestedatt--customer_gets--value--amount"></a>
### Nested Schema for `customer_gets.value.amount`

Required:

- `amount` (String) The amount in the shop currency, as a decimal string. Compared numerically, so `"5"` matches Shopify's `"5.0"`.

Optional:

- `applies_on_each_item` (Boolean) Whether the amount comes off each selected item instead of once per order. Defaults to `false`; must be `false` when `items` is `all`.




<a id="nestedatt--combines_with"></a>
### Nested Schema for `combines_with`

Optional:

- `order_discounts` (Boolean) Whether it combines with order discounts. Defaults to `false` when `combines_with` is set.
- `product_discounts` (Boolean) Whether it combines with product discounts. Defaults to `false` when `combines_with` is set.
- `shipping_discounts` (Boolean) Whether it combines with shipping discounts. Defaults to `false` when `combines_with` is set.


<a id="nestedatt--context"></a>
### Nested Schema for `context`

Optional:

- `all` (Boolean) All buyers. Must be `true`.
- `customer_segment_ids` (Set of String) Customer segment GIDs.
- `market_ids` (Set of String) Market GIDs; reference `shopify_market` IDs.


<a id="nestedatt--minimum_requirement"></a>
### Nested Schema for `minimum_requirement`

Optional:

- `quantity` (Number) Minimum number of eligible items.
- `subtotal` (String) Minimum subtotal of the eligible items, as a decimal string. Compared numerically, so `"50"` matches Shopify's `"50.0"`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# code/<code> for a code discount, automatic/<title> for an automatic one
terraform import shopify_discount_basic.newsletter code/WILLKOMMEN10
terraform import shopify_discount_basic.five_off "automatic/5 € Rabatt"
```
